title: Regularised double shuffle relations for planar Arborified Zeta Values
summary: We endow spaces of decorated planar rooted trees with new dendriform and tridendrifrom algebra structures and provide their combinatorial description. We then show that the planar counterparts of Arborified Zeta Values are algebra morphisms for these shuffle and quasi-shuffle products of planar rooted trees. We also prove an arborified version of Hoffman's regularisation relation for Arborified Zeta Values.
